design_rules.spacing: Generous (p-6, p-8) for containers, Tight (gap-2, gap-4) for data grids
design_rules.radius: rounded-lg (8px) for cards, rounded-full for buttons
design_rules.shadows: shadow-sm for cards, shadow-md for floating actions

cards.style: Flat with 1px border (#E2E8F0), no shadow by default, lift on hover

buttons.primary: bg-[#7CB342] hover:bg-[#689F38] text-white rounded-md font-semibold px-4 py-2 shadow-sm transition-all
buttons.secondary: bg-white border border-gray-200 text-gray-700 hover:bg-gray-50 rounded-md px-4 py-2

tables.style: Clean, distinct rows, light gray header bg

badges.style: Pill shaped, subtle background, dark text

implementation_instructions.styling: Tailwind CSS + inline styles for dynamic values
implementation_instructions.animation: Framer Motion (if available) or CSS Transitions

pipeline_status.concept: Flow visualization using connected cards or a stepper

draft_queue.concept: Visual meter/gauge showing capacity vs current load
draft_queue.style: Clean progress bars with distinct segments

activity_log.bg: bg-slate-900 text-green-400 (if dark) or bg-gray-50 text-gray-700 (if light)

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text is legible on colored badges
accessibility.focus: Visible focus rings on all interactive elements
